# Just My Plan

> Just My Plan is a planning app that puts tasks, calendar and an AI assistant in one screen, so you can plan your day without switching between apps.

Made by Rinse Nieboer, Rotterdam. Available as a web app and as an iPhone app in the App Store.

## Features
- Tasks and lists, with reminders and repeating tasks.
- Calendar view, including import from Apple and Google calendars on iPhone.
- AI assistant that creates, moves and reschedules tasks and appointments on request.
- Sign in with Apple, push notifications.
